params.body:
Refs #658

## Why

Since #1065, the Car-Pass chip of a car without a stored PDF opens the report at Car-Pass, the public link in `carpass_id`. Before, it gave a 404. The chip still looks the same as the one that opens a PDF, so a dealer who expects a PDF lands on another site without warning. The sheet had two smaller gaps:
- After a confirmed unknown chassis number, the history said "PDF" next to a report that has no file.
- A car whose Car-Pass is only a link has no registration to list, so the sheet said nothing about where its report is.

## What changes

- **The chip in the list** gets a small arrow pointing outward, and the hint "Bekijk bij Car-Pass", when the car has a link and no stored report. A car with a PDF keeps its chip as it was. So does every car when the list cannot tell, for example on the classic list.
- **The list asks this once per page**, and only for the cars whose chip is a link: `CarpassLink::withStoredReport`. The query reads only `vehicle_id`, never the report rows themselves, which carry the PDF in base64. A page without such cars asks nothing, so the issue state still costs one query (`CarpassIssueChipTest`).
- **The history on the sheet** marks a report without a file (`CarpassHistory` adds `file`) and shows "Bekijk bij Car-Pass" with the arrow instead of the PDF icon.
- **A sheet of a car with only a link** gets one line that says where the report is, with the same link.
- New words are in nl, fr, en and de. Rule R S3-4.8 now describes this.

## Tests

- `TheCarpassChipSaysWhereItOpensTest`, 4 tests:
  - the chip in its three states: link only, with a PDF, and unknown;
  - one query per page, which never reads `data`;
  - the sheet for a report without a file, a car with only a link, and a car with a PDF;
  - the new words in four languages.
- Locally: PHPStan, pint on the new test, and the Car-Pass, list and CSS tests pass. In the full suite, the only failure is `APhotoWithoutAForegroundIsNotAFaultTest`, which also fails on this workbench without this change and passed in CI on #1064 and #1065.
params.title: Say that the Car-Pass chip opens at Car-Pass when there is no PDF
